sources.observation: Three recessed arches support the asymmetrical west front. The Saint-Michel tower rises on the right, with a tiled hip over the shorter left bay.
The aerial shows separate clay-tile roofs over the nave, transept and radiating chapels. Flying buttresses bridge above the outer roofs.

limitations: Sculpture, roof profiles and individual stones are medium-fi exterior interpretations. The nave interior is outside the model.
